disposition_reason: Condition-permitted 170-cell training-count loading is implemented, closing the unsafe test-response-open branch. Stimulus preparation, RF fitting, complete protected scoring and matched interpretation packets remain missing.

scientific_target.question: Can a condition-matched model predict held-out retinal ganglion-cell spike counts from white-noise/natural-movie stimuli, and does spatial contrast improve predictions over mean-intensity encoding?
scientific_target.known_answer: Protected per-cell spike counts at each 85 Hzprojector update and repeat-averaged responses, with physical event/grid alignment authenticated.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Original t43ph1 two-preparation recordings; observed held-out spikes are target measurements, not paper table values.170 classified cells were historically selected using test reliability.
scientific_target.case_unit: Full stimulus sequence/timebase and frozen cell identity; scoring at every protected update/repeat for all 170 selected cells.
scientific_target.independent_unit: Two retinal preparations; mapping to animals and biological independence unresolved. Cells, bins and repeated stimuli are nested.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Stimulus-to-response prediction and conditional cross-stimulus transfer in the historically selected cohort; encoding accuracy alone is not direct native neural interpretation.
exclusions: The expanded four-retina processed library is not automatically the original two-preparation task.
Strict source-only new fitting does not erase historical test-dependent cell selection.
LargeOFF is a pooled class, not one established cell type.

inputs: Training/calibration spike counts only from condition-permittedWN/NMstreams, explicit immutable count dtype/units, selected cell/trial/frame identity and independently prepared matching stimuli/timebase.
Protected cases expose stimulus/timebase and opaque cell IDs only; no held-out response traces or derived summaries.
forbidden_inputs: Protected test counts/rasters/repeat means and all response-derived target statistics.
Original WN STA and target-domain calibration in strict transfer; original get_data(responses=False) is unsafe because it opens test responses first.
observation_contract.case_identity: Adapter requires two named original preparations and 170 opaque 32 hex cell IDs with authenticated external joins;51 off_midget, 69 off_parasol, 35 on_parasol, 15 large_off_pooled. Actual per-preparation roster/seed memberships remain external.
observation_contract.split: Preserve original nonrepeating training versus frozen test stimulus split. Group original source frames with all jitter/flips/repeats and guard full temporal context. Strict source-only fitting and explicitlyWN-assisted conditions remain separate.
observation_contract.coverage: Training adapter projects all 170 selected cells and every declared permitted training trial/frame/seed in both preparations across six information conditions. A policy can omit a native seed unnoticed without an authenticated census; six conditions remain one registration.

primary.name: Per-cell held-out repeat-average Pearson correlation, equal-preparation descriptive summary
primary.aggregation: Correlation over all eligible protected updates per cell; median within preparation/stimulus and equal-preparation descriptive summary. Report paired difference against a frozen condition-matched spatial-contrast baseline.
primary.rationale: Matches source response encoding while retaining both preparations and condition-specific calibration access; does not create independent-animal inference.

secondary: Mean Poisson negative log likelihood on individual held-out repeats in count units with predeclared positive rate floor.
In-domain versus cross-domain change, all-cell/preparation support and class-conditional paired descriptive effects.
Undefined constant-target/prediction correlations retained explicitly; primary decision requires a frozen coverage policy.

comparators.name: Regularized LN
comparators.inputs: Identical condition-permitted stimuli/counts and source-onlyRF/STA calibration
comparators.procedure: Train-only temporal/spatial filters and softplusPoisson fitting; paperNM route usingWN STA belongs to mixed calibration, not strictNM-only.

comparators.name: Spatial-contrast and competent CNN
comparators.inputs: Same frozen cells/split/stimuli and identical permitted calibration evidence
comparators.procedure: Proposed contrast versusLN and tunedCNN comparisons with fixed development-only selection; no authentic reference run is supplied.

nuisance_controls: Historical 170 cell test-reliability ascertainment must accompany every score; no new quality filtering using protected targets.
NMmean light/contrast differ fromWN; transfer failure alone is not adaptation.
Verify stimulus/STA orientation, seed-specific repeat sequences and smoothing selection; no averaging nonmatching test repeats.
Choose predictive smoothing on permitted development only; historical test-selected optimum remains retrospective.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report each preparation and within-preparation distributions. Repeat-noise summaries condition on fixed preparations/models; do not bootstrap 170 cells as independent animals or claim two independent biological clusters before animal mapping.
evaluation.failure_policy: Training loader requires all declared permitted streams/cells/trials/frames and rejects missing or malformed counts without returning earlier partial success. Future complete scorer must refuse missing predictions and retain undefined-correlation coverage rather than silently remove cells.

implementation.scorer_target: No scorer delivered. prepare_training authenticates only permitted training NPY leaves and projects typed count buffers; it never loads test responses or originalSTA, fits a model or supplies stimuli.
implementation.delivered_scope: Exact count-preserving response adapter for full declared 170 cell scope and six calibration conditions. Original source census, stimulus pipeline, complete protected packet and metric remain unqualified.
missing: Authentic 170/180 cell original census, seed/trial/frame clocks, source-to-cell mapping and animal relationship.
Target-independent stimulus reconstruction and validatedNM-only RF/STA estimation.
Competent condition-matched baselines, undefined-coverage scoring, protected prediction lifecycle and interpretation study.
implementation.execution_evidence: Generated count/layout/dtype/protected-open controls establish software behavior only. No original neural arrays or new native fitting/scoring operation were executed in this revision.

direct_observation.representation: Pure protected encoding cases contain stimuli rather than observed query neural activity; visible calibration traces would support a separately specified matched interpretation diagnostic.
direct_observation.boundary: Exposing protected spikes to make a neural picture would disclose the scored target; current programme scores cannot establish direct understanding.
missing: Define a nonleaking calibration-based or masked-observation interpretation estimand before enabling this mode.

typed_viewer.representation: No target-preserving viewer interpretation task is currently defined for stimulus-to-protected-response encoding.
typed_viewer.boundary: A calibration-only viewer could be a future matched condition, but protected target rasters/means must never be rendered.
missing: Separate observation/target mask and complete view policy, not a renamed programme score.

tool_assisted.representation: Proposed train-only numerical/model investigation using prepared stimuli and permitted calibration counts.
tool_assisted.boundary: Source-only versusWN-assisted domains enforced at access; calibration_only labels alone do not enforce downstream fitting.
missing: Complete stimuli/case packets, constrained fit tools and protected scorer.

frozen_program.representation: Proposed frozen response predictor over every protected stimulus update.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze cell roster, fit/normalization/smoothing and calibration route before queries; current loader is only one preparation component.
missing: Complete prediction/scoring lifecycle and competent reference qualification.

summary: Separate stimulus-to-response encoding from direct interpretation instead of forcing a viewer onto protected target arrays.
Recognize implemented safe training-response loading while retaining absent stimulus/scoring andNM-onlycalibration gates.
Preserve original two-preparation 170 selected-cell estimand and historical target-based selection beside every transfer condition.
revision.source_review: Reviewed preserved scientific registration and named implementation code/documentation; reused cited primary source evidence already verified in these records. No scientific arrays or evaluator labels were opened in this revision.
